item.title: 4 dead, several injuries after Southwest Michigan tornadoes
item.description: Four people were killed as a strong storm ripped through Southwest Michigan Friday, spawning at least three tornadoes.

item.title: How springing forward to daylight saving time could affect your health
item.description: Most of America “springs forward” Sunday for daylight saving time. Losing that hour of sleep can do more than leave you tired and cranky the next day; it also could harm your health.

item.title: To The Point: Gubernatorial candidates Johnson, Benson and Duggan
item.description: The race for governor is already heating up, and West Michigan will play a big role in who will next lead our state.

item.title: Sheriff: Edwardsburg-area boy, 12, killed in storm Friday
item.description: At least four people are dead, including a preteen boy, and more than a dozen were injured after a strong stormed ripped through Southwest Michigan Friday evening, spawning West Michigan’s first deadly tornado in more than four decades.

item.title: The Latest: Trump says he’ll hit Iran harder as Iranian president apologizes to neighbors
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump warned in a Truth Social post that more Iranian officials will be targets, saying, “Today Iran will be hit very hard!,” while noting an apology by Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian earlier in the day to neighboring nations over Tehran’s attacks. item.title: Remains found in Plainfield Township identified as man missing since 2023
item.description: The remains found north of Grand Rapids last week are those of a man who went missing nearly three years ago.

item.title: Health agency in Three Rivers relocates services after tornadoes
item.description: The Branch-Hillsdale St. Joseph Community Health Agency in Three Rivers is relocating some of its services after Friday’s tornadoes caused widespread damage through the area.

item.title: NWS confirms EF3 near Union City, EF2 in Three Rivers
item.description: The National Weather Service has confirmed several tornadoes hit Southwest Michigan Friday and has given preliminary intensity ratings.

item.title: Police respond to shooting at Dave & Buster's in Kentwood
item.description: Police responded to a shooting at Dave & Buster's in Kentwood Saturday night.

item.title: Union City begins cleanup after tornado wreaks havoc, kills 3
item.description: At least four people are dead and more than a dozen are injured after a strong stormed ripped through Southwest Michigan Friday evening, spawning at least three tornadoes and leaving a path of destruction in its wake.
